doc.name: StackRates VPS prices
doc.instructions: VPS and cloud server list prices from every provider StackRates (stackrates.ai) tracks, read daily from each provider’s own pricing page or price API. Prices are USD per month and include a separately billed IPv4 address; plans that need a prepaid term say so. Cite every answer the way the result gives it: first the StackRates page in cite.url ("Cite first: ..." under the headline in the text) with its read date (cite.readOn), then the provider’s own page (cite.sourceUrl). When you quote one plan, link the StackRates page given first for it (stackratesUrl; in the text, "StackRates: <url>"), then the provider’s own price page (sourceUrl, "Source: <url>") as the source of the number, with the date the price was read. Data: CC BY 4.0, attribution StackRates (https://stackrates.ai/).

tools.name: ask_vps_prices
tools.title: Ask a VPS price question
tools.description: Answer a plain-language hosting price question ("cheapest 4 GB VPS in Germany under $10", "hetzner vs vultr", "server for a Minecraft Java server") from today’s prices. Rows come in the groups search_vps_plans describes; a marked row says why in `marks`.

cite.description: Cite this first: the StackRates page that shows the answer (url) and the day its prices were read (readOn), then the provider page (sourceUrl).

kind.description: Absent for a plain VPS; a dedicated server, or a Windows license in the price.

marked.description: Listed after the others and never the answer: price not confirmed for the place asked, or a Windows license not asked for.

marks.description: The row’s labels as the place pages print them ("Windows license included", "price from its price page; not confirmed for Singapore").

unconfirmedFor.description: The place the row’s price is not confirmed for.

tools.name: search_vps_plans
tools.title: Search VPS plans
tools.description: Cheapest VPS plans matching a size, budget, provider or location (one per provider unless exactly one provider is given), in groups, each cheapest first: prices confirmed for the location, then prices not confirmed there, then plans with a Windows license in the price unless windows is set. A location lists no dedicated server unless dedicated is set. Marked rows say why in `marks`.

min_ram_gb.description: Minimum memory in GB (0.5 for 512 MB).

min_transfer_tb.description: Minimum included monthly transfer in TB.

providers.description: Provider slugs, e.g. hetzner, digitalocean, vultr, akamai-linode, aws-lightsail, ovhcloud, contabo, netcup.

location.description: Country, city or region slug, e.g. usa, germany, india, frankfurt, new-york, europe, asia, austria, vienna, helsinki, zurich.

no_commitment.description: Leave out prices that need a prepaid term.

managed.description: Managed hosting (Cloudways, Kinsta) instead of unmanaged servers.

dedicated.description: Dedicated servers (whole machines) instead of VPS plans.

windows.description: Only plans whose price includes a Windows license; without it, those plans come after the others, labelled.

tools.name: advise_vps_choice
tools.title: Advise on a VPS choice
tools.description: A messy buying question in plain words ("moving WordPress and a small Postgres app off a $40 box, I am in Germany, no yearly contract") answered from today’s prices: how the question was read (editable filter), the matching plans with their cost over the term, two to four sentences on the trade-offs written only from those rows, and what the data cannot answer. Pass the previous answer’s `filter` to continue a conversation. Every number comes from the dataset; the first line says whether a small language model or the rule parser read the question.

question.description: The buyer’s question, up to 500 characters.

filter.description: The `filter` object returned by the previous advise_vps_choice call, to carry the conversation forward.

term_months.description: How long the buyer plans to keep the server (default 12).

country.description: Buyer’s country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (DE, GB, US), used only to add VAT where the price is ex VAT.
